notes: Battery and noise control, on the Xiaomi RCSP service 0000fd2d. The Fast Pair Message Stream answers with a model id and no battery frame. Two reads open the session (GetDeviceConfig 11, GetTargetInfo); the battery is attribute 7 (left 75, right 80, case 100, confirmed against the Xiaomi Earbuds app) and config 11 is state, level with state 0 off, 1 cancelling, 2 transparency. A set writes config 11 and the earbuds announce the new state on their own. Nothing is printed until the mode and the battery are both known.
